0022600185.text: The Los Angeles Lakers (5-2, first in the Pacific, 5th in the West) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-6, 15th in the West, fifth in the Pacific and four games back) in the Lakers' ninth game of the 2026-27 season. The Lakers are 3-1 at home and 2-1 on the road, while the Kings are 0-2 at home and have gone 1-6 over their last ten games. The Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1 and beat Sacramento 128-104 in their most recent meeting, in Los Angeles on March 1, 2026, and the 2026-27 season series has no games yet; Adou Thiero is out for the Lakers with knee inflammation, and Sacramento will be without Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee).
